# Project Brief & Objectives

The goal of this exercise is to analyze the **Body Mass Index (BMI)** of characters in the *Star Wars* universe using modern `tidyverse` / `dplyr` pipelines.

BMI is defined as: $$BMI = \frac{\text{Mass}}{(\text{Height} / 100)^2}$$ where $\text{Mass}$ is in kilograms ($\text{kg}$) and $\text{Height}$ is recorded in centimeters ($\text{cm}$) in the dataset.

### Core Deliverable

Create a clean summary table that displays **only the names, homelands (homeworld), species, and BMIs** of those characters whose BMI exceeds the **average BMI on Tatooine**, with the characters grouped by homeland and listed in **descending order of BMI**.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Data Management

## RMarkdown Preparation & Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(skimr)
```

## Data Loading

We load the native `starwars` dataset bundled with `dplyr`:

```{r load-starwars}
starwars <- dplyr::starwars
cat("Initial dataset dimensions:", nrow(starwars), "characters and", ncol(starwars), "attributes.\n")
```

## Data Quality Check

We inspect the completeness of key variables (`height`, `mass`, `homeworld`):

```{r quality-check}
# Check missing value counts in key fields
na_summary <- starwars %>%
  summarise(
    total_characters = n(),
    missing_height = sum(is.na(height)),
    missing_mass = sum(is.na(mass)),
    missing_homeworld = sum(is.na(homeworld))
  )

kable(na_summary, caption = "Missing Values Assessment")
```

## Data Cleaning

We filter out records with missing values (`NA`) in `height` or `mass` so that BMI can be rigorously computed:

```{r cleaning}
starwars_clean <- starwars %>%
  filter(!is.na(height) & !is.na(mass)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(homeworld))

cat("Cleaned sample size:", nrow(starwars_clean), "characters with complete biometric data.\n")
```

## Data Selection & Feature Engineering (New Variables)

We compute the `BMI` variable and select the relevant operational columns:

```{r feature-engineering}
starwars_bmi <- starwars_clean %>%
  mutate(
    height_m = height / 100,
    BMI = mass / (height_m^2)
  ) %>%
  select(name, species, homeworld, height, mass, BMI)

# Display preview
starwars_bmi %>% head(6) %>% kable(digits = 2, caption = "First 6 Records with Computed BMI")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Data Exploration & Benchmark Computation

## Summary Statistics

```{r summary-stats}
starwars_bmi %>%
  select(height, mass, BMI) %>%
  skim()
```

## Benchmark: Average BMI on Tatooine

We isolate characters originating from **Tatooine** and calculate their benchmark mean BMI:

```{r tatooine-benchmark}
# Tatooine characters subset
tatooine_chars <- starwars_bmi %>%
  filter(homeworld == "Tatooine")

# Average BMI calculation
tatooine_avg_bmi <- mean(tatooine_chars$BMI, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Average BMI on Tatooine:", round(tatooine_avg_bmi, 2), "kg/m²\n")
```

```{r tatooine-table}
kable(
  tatooine_chars %>% select(name, species, height, mass, BMI),
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Tatooine Reference Group"
)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Final Result & Deliverable

## Characters Exceeding Tatooine Benchmark (Grouped & Ordered)

We filter characters whose $BMI > \overline{BMI}_{\text{Tatooine}}$, group by `homeworld`, and arrange in descending order of BMI:

```{r final-table}
final_bmi_report <- starwars_bmi %>%
  filter(BMI > tatooine_avg_bmi) %>%
  group_by(homeworld) %>%
  arrange(homeworld, desc(BMI)) %>%
  select(name, homeworld, species, BMI)

kable(
  final_bmi_report,
  digits = 2,
  caption = paste("Characters with BMI > Tatooine Average (", round(tatooine_avg_bmi, 2), " kg/m²), Grouped by Homeworld")
)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Visual Distribution

```{r bmi-plot, fig.height=6}
# Top 15 characters visual comparison with Tatooine threshold
top_characters <- starwars_bmi %>%
  filter(BMI > tatooine_avg_bmi) %>%
  arrange(desc(BMI)) %>%
  head(12)

ggplot(top_characters, aes(x = reorder(name, BMI), y = BMI, fill = homeworld)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = TRUE, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = tatooine_avg_bmi, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 3, y = tatooine_avg_bmi + 25, 
           label = paste("Tatooine Mean (", round(tatooine_avg_bmi, 1), ")"), color = "red", fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top Star Wars Characters Exceeding Tatooine Benchmark BMI",
    subtitle = "Calculated via dplyr pipeline",
    x = "Character Name",
    y = "Body Mass Index (BMI)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
